cards.ex: We're going to ring in the New Year with a big party at my friend's house.
cards.exUz: Biz do'stimning uyida katta ziyofat bilan Yangi yilni kutib olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi yilning boshlanishini nishonlash, odatda shovqin bilan.

cards.ex: I'm going to throw a party for my birthday next month.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi oyda tug'ilgan kunim uchun ziyofat o'tkazmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror sababga ko'ra odamlarni yig'ib, xursandchilik qilmoq.

cards.ex: The whole family gets together for Thanksgiving every year.
cards.exUz: Butun oila har yili Minnatdorchilik kuni uchun yig'iladi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda bayram yoki dam olish kuni munosabati bilan birga bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: We had a real feast for Christmas dinner.
cards.exUz: Rojdestvo kechki ovqati uchun bizda haqiqiy to'kin dasturxon bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p turli xil ovqatlar bilan to'ldirilgan katta ovqat.

cards.ex: We're going out to dinner to mark the occasion of our anniversary.
cards.exUz: Biz yilligimiz munosabati bilan kechki ovqatga chiqamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror muhim voqeani maxsus nishonlash.

cards.ex: The holiday spirit is really strong in our town this year.
cards.exUz: Bu yil bizning shaharda bayram kayfiyati juda kuchli.
cards.uzDef: Bayramlar paytida odamlarning xursandchilik va mehr-oqibat hissi.

cards.ex: We always dress up for our company's holiday party.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim kompaniyamizning bayram ziyofati uchun chiroyli kiyinamiz.
cards.uzDef: Maxsus holat uchun chiroyli va rasmiy kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: We exchange gifts with our family on Christmas morning.
cards.exUz: Biz Rojdestvo kuni ertalab oilamiz bilan sovg'a almashamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biringizga sovg'alar bermoq, odatda Rojdestvo yoki tug'ilgan kunda.

cards.ex: Come on, join in the fun! We're playing party games.
cards.exUz: Qani, xursandchilikka qo'shiling! Biz o'yinlar o'ynayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning qiziqarli va xursandchilik bilan shug'ullanishiga qo'shilish.

cards.ex: We light up the house with Christmas lights every year.
cards.exUz: Biz har yili uyni Rojdestvo chiroqlari bilan yoritamiz.
cards.uzDef: Chiroqlar, shamlar yoqish va bayramona bezaklar bilan bezash.

cards.ex: This restaurant is perfect for a special occasion.
cards.exUz: Bu restoran maxsus holat uchun juda mos keladi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim va nishonlanishi kerak bo'lgan voqea.

cards.ex: Let's raise a toast to the happy couple!
cards.exUz: Keling, baxtli juftlik sharafiga qadah ko'taraylik!
cards.uzDef: Biror kishi yoki voqeani sharaflash uchun qadah ko'tarib nutq so'zlamoq.

cards.ex: It's a family tradition to open presents on Christmas Eve.
cards.exUz: Rojdestvo arafasida sovg'alarni ochish oilaviy an'ana.
cards.uzDef: Oilada har yili takrorlanadigan maxsus odat.

cards.ex: The festival celebrates our cultural heritage.
cards.exUz: Festival bizning madaniy merosimizni nishonlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Avloddan avlodga o'tadigan urf-odatlar, an'analar va e'tiqodlar.

cards.ex: These traditions have been passed down for generations.
cards.exUz: Bu an'analar avloddan avlodga o'tib kelgan.
cards.uzDef: Avloddan avlodga o'tkazmoq (an'analar, bilimlarni).

cards.ex: The party was in full swing by the time we arrived.
cards.exUz: Biz kelganimizda ziyofat qizg'in paytida edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa eng faol va qizg'in paytida.

cards.ex: We had a blast at the carnival last night.
cards.exUz: Biz kecha karnavalda juda zo'r vaqt o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi va qiziqarli vaqt o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: He's such a party animal; he's always out dancing.
cards.exUz: U juda ziyofat muxlisi; u doimo raqsga tushish uchun tashqarida.
cards.uzDef: Ziyofatlarni yaxshi ko'radigan va ularda doimo qatnashadigan odam.

cards.ex: We're going to decorate for Halloween this weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz bu hafta oxiri Xellouin uchun bezatamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bayramga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun joyni bezatmoq.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to the holiday break.
cards.exUz: Men haqiqatan ham bayram ta'tilini intiqlik bilan kutyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa sodir bo'lishini juda xohlamoq va kutmoq.

cards.ex: It's hard not to get into the spirit of Christmas with all the decorations around.
cards.exUz: Atrofdagi barcha bezaklar bilan Rojdestvo kayfiyatiga kirmaslik qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Bayramona kayfiyatda bo'lmoq va bayramni his qilmoq.

cards.ex: The festival pays tribute to the country's founders.
cards.exUz: Festival mamlakat asoschilariga hurmat bajo keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini yoki narsani hurmat qilish uchun biror narsa qilmoq.

cards.ex: It's good to let loose and have some fun sometimes.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan o'zingizni erkin qo'yib, xursand bo'lish yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni erkin his qilish, xursand bo'lish va tashvishlanmaslik.

cards.ex: This anniversary marks a significant milestone in their relationship.
cards.exUz: Bu yillik ularning munosabatlarida muhim bosqichni belgilaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim voqeani yoki yutuqni nishonlamoq.

cards.ex: We're going to deck the halls with boughs of holly.
cards.exUz: Biz zallarni eman shoxlari bilan bezatamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bayram uchun xonani bezak bilan bezamoq (Rojdestvo)

cards.ex: She was on cloud nine after she got engaged.
cards.exUz: U unashtirilganidan keyin etti osmonda edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baxtli va xursand bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Let's go out and paint the town red tonight!
cards.exUz: Keling, bugun tashqariga chiqib, xursandchilik qilaylik!
cards.uzDef: Xursandchilik qilish va kechani o'tkazish.

cards.ex: This festival is a time-honored tradition in our village.
cards.exUz: Bu festival bizning qishloqda qadimiy an'ana hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida mavjud bo'lgan va hurmat qilinadigan an'ana.

cards.ex: We went to the funeral to pay our respects.
cards.exUz: Biz dafn marosimiga hurmat bajo keltirish uchun bordik.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishi o'limidan keyin unga hurmat bajo keltirmoq.

cards.ex: We'll mark his retirement with a big celebration.
cards.exUz: Biz uning nafaqaga chiqishini katta nishonlash bilan belgilaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani nishonlash bilan yodda saqlamoq.
